subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a part of aggregate demand in an economy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Increase in population.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aggregate demand** is the total demand for goods and services in an economy at a given time.
 
• It **comprises four components**: consumption, investment, government spending, and net exports.
 
• **Increase in population is not a part of aggregate demand.**
 
• **Consumption **refers to the spending by households on goods and services.
 
 
• It is the largest component of aggregate demand.
 
 
 
• **Investment** includes spending by businesses on capital goods such as machinery, equipment, and buildings.
 
 
• It also includes spending on research and development and the creation of new businesses.
 
 
 
• **Government spending** includes all the expenditures made by the government on goods and services, such as defense, education, healthcare, and infrastructure.
 
• **Net exports** refer to the difference between the value of exports and imports.
 
 
• When the value of exports is greater than imports, it is called a **trade surplus**, and when the value of imports is greater than exports, it is called a **trade deficit.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Imports** are a part of aggregate demand as they **represent the spending by households, businesses, and the government on foreign goods and services.**
 
• **Capital goods** are a part of aggregate demand as they **represent the spending by businesses** on the production of goods and services.
 
• **Exports** are a part of aggregate demand as they **represent the demand for goods and services** from foreign countries.
